description: Fast Lane 3.0 predictive error knowledge base — known build failure signatures, their categories, and safe patches.

failures.description: A dependency requires a higher compileSdk than the project declares.
failures.patch: Raise compileSdk in build.gradle to the required value (34 or higher).

failures.description: A dependency coordinate could not be resolved from configured repositories.
failures.patch: Verify the dependency coordinate exists in mavenCentral()/google(); use a stable pinned version.

failures.description: Code or a dependency calls APIs above the configured minSdk.
failures.patch: Add API guards (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT) or raise minSdk only if agreed.

failures.description: A @string/@color/@drawable reference in a layout or manifest does not resolve.
failures.patch: Add the referenced resource to src/main/res/values/ resources; verify naming.

failures.description: A resource/layout XML file is not well-formed.
failures.patch: Fix the XML syntax error (unclosed tag, invalid entity, duplicate attribute).

failures.description: The manifest is missing the package attribute or it is invalid.
failures.patch: Set package/namespace to the applicationId in the manifest or build.gradle.

failures.description: AGP expects a namespace element; legacy package-only configuration fails.
Duplicate method bodies or mixed bytecode versions in merged dependencies.
failures.patch: Check for duplicate dependency coordinates; align dependency versions.

failures.description: A unit test asserted something that did not hold.
failures.patch: Fix the assertion or the logic under test; test must assert real behavior.

failures.description: The Android SDK license has not been accepted on this runner.
failures.patch: Accept licenses via sdkmanager --licenses or the CI image pre-configuration.

failures.description: A repository URL uses an insecure protocol (http).
Gradle could not download a dependency from the network.
failures.patch: Retry the build (transient); pin versions in dependency policy if recurring.
